definitions.explanation: A lottery or prize draw typically held at shopping streets, department stores, or festivals, where participants draw lots (often by pulling strings, spinning a wheel, or drawing a ball from a box) to win prizes.

examples.english: I won first prize in the lucky draw.

examples.japanese: ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{福引|ふくび}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

examples.english: A lucky draw event was held at the shopping street at year's end, bustling with many customers.

notes:
USAGE:
A traditional form of promotional lottery in Japan. The classic format involves a spinning drum (⟦がらがら→がらがら：04820_garagara⟧) from which colored balls fall out, with each color corresponding to a prize tier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {福引|ふくび}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to draw in a lucky draw)
- {福引|ふくび}き⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (lucky draw ticket)
- {福引|ふくび}き⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (lucky draw event)
- {福引|ふくび}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to win in a lucky draw)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Often seen during ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧ (year-end) sales and ⟦{歳末|さいまつ}→歳末：15339_saimatsu⟧{大売|おおう}り{出|だ}し (end-of-year sales), and at ⟦{縁日|えんにち}→縁日：10620_ennichi⟧ (festival days) at shrines and temples.
